> **Tested on one unit, with the older flash chip.** DØG-5 is built and tested on a real M-VAVE FM-1 with the
> **Puya P25Q80** flash chip (JEDEC `0x856014`). Newer FM-1s carry the **UC25HQ80** (JEDEC `0xB36014`): the update
> loader accepts it, but DØG-5 has **never been installed or played on one**, so we cannot speak to how it behaves
> there. On a newer unit, keep M-Flasher and your backup ready, and please report what happens.

Install from Chrome or Edge: <https://vincentzsk-prod.github.io/dog5/install/>. If the unit will not boot: M-Flasher and
your backup. GPL-3.0-only; the source is this repository at this tag.
